task: Core 1186 U09: read-only fail-closed Digital Office staging DB RLS and migration readiness gate, no schema changes

assuranceCeiling.rationale: Authority-bearing RLS drift detection must be fail-closed against missing/malformed/stale reports, while never upgrading static observation to final security proof.

acceptanceCriteria: Fail-closed BLOCK when any of the three Office table policy sets uses legacy ALL or lacks an exact authenticated SELECT row gate.
Fail-closed BLOCK when privacy migration, membership hardening, helper exposure closure or target function is missing.
Reject missing, stale, invalid or unscoped inputs; never consider an empty policy list as safe.
Provide the exact required canonical SQL snapshot query so the gate can be run without DB writes and without guessing schema.
Only READY_FOR_VERIFICATION for a structurally clean, recent supplied snapshot; never claim authoritative RLS DONE based on static JSON.
Negative test covers legacy actual staging policy facts: three PERMISSIVE ALL can_manage_support policies and missing can_read function/migrations.
Critical Plan Before Code, Edit-Time Reference Sync, Atlas, Replay, Risk, exact-head CI, Truth and Lifecycle required; issue #1186 remains PARTIAL.
TypeScript declares the new read-only JS analyzer contract without implicitly typed callback or module imports; no ts-ignore suppression.
invariants: No direct DB mutation or network call from the preflight tool; supplied snapshots are read-only, operator-provided evidence.
Never use platform role or user-editable JWT profile metadata as plan authority.
Worker/service role bypass not certified merely because browser-side RLS appears safe.
Keep Alap transactional email/support outside the Digital Office Pro-only workspace.
Never silently accept missing migration provenance or run-id as success.
forbiddenStates: The legacy staging ALL policies yield READY.
A function-name-only positive without row policies yields READY.
One of the Office tables lacks the expected read policy but is silently ignored.
An incomplete/old snapshot yields authoritative production-like closure.
Any schema, seed, migration history, entitlement or production environment is changed.

Matching policies but no authenticated role

Valid modern snapshot still cannot assert full plan/tenant proof

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The repository includes Digital Office restrictive participant read RLS migrations, but the real read-only staging catalog shows legacy ALL policies on office_threads, office_messages, office_tasks and no installed can_read_office_thread_v1 helper. The migration ledger lacks later Office privacy/RLS releases. A staged/production-like acceptance claim must fail closed on this drift before any data mutation.
observableOutcomes: A credential-free, read-only snapshot analyzer reports exact missing canonical migration versions and RLS/function gaps against the actual Supabase pg_catalog evidence shape.
A legacy staging report with office_* ALL permissive policies, missing privacy migration/function must BLOCK, never certify Office as Pro/RLS ready.

A modern candidate with expected SELECT policies/function/migrations may only REPORT READY_FOR_VERIFICATION, not authoritative production closure; real tenant role and upgrade/downgrade behavior needs separate proof.
No database schema or data is modified, no production or staging migrations are applied and #1186 remains OPEN/PARTIAL.
unresolvedRisks: An exported JSON snapshot is not cryptographically authoritative or a substitute for a live authenticated role proof.
Staging is behind multiple migrations and a selective policy patch could conflict with pending upstream schema changes.
Service-role RPC and per-tenant plan transitions remain outside this bounded preflight.
